models.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (opencode CLI)
models.disabled_reason: The opencode CLI injects opencode's own agent context around the request. A captured pilot answer contained 'I did not make any tool calls... must be some kind of injection', so the CLI path cannot measure the model: it measures the model plus opencode's wrapper. Use the equivalent OpenAI-compatible endpoint instead: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/chat/completions with an OpenCode Console key (see _example_enabled_openai_http below).

_example_enabled_openai_http._comment: Commented example, ignored by the roster loader. Once you have a fresh OpenCode Console key, replace the disabled opencode-deepseek entry above with this object and add an app registry entry with the same registry_id (base_url https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1, model deepseek-v4.1-flash, api_key_env OPENCODE_API_KEY). Then run: python -m bench.cli providers --roster bench/models.json
_example_enabled_openai_http.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (OpenCode Zen, production path)
